title: Meeting Slavko

objectives.label: Say your name
objectives.descriptorEN: Answer 'Kako ti je ime?' out loud with your own name.

objectives.label: Introduce yourself
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the frame 'Sem ___.' with your own name in the slot.

objectives.label: Say goodbye
objectives.descriptorEN: Return Slavko's farewell with 'Adijo' after hearing him say it.

frameEN: Practice Speaking, then press the button to continue

c1.speaker: client
c1.en: (your own name, spoken on its own)

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Me veseli! Jaz sem Slavko. Zdaj pa še ti.
n2.en: Nice to meet you! I'm Slavko. Now your turn.
n2.deliverySL: [cheerfully] Me veseli! Jaz sem Slavko. Zdaj pa še ti.
n2.slowSL: Me veseli … Jaz sem Slavko … Zdaj pa še ti.
n2.deliverySlowSL: [slower] Me veseli … [deliberately] Jaz sem Slavko … [slower] Zdaj pa še ti.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Lepo, da sva se spoznala. Adijo!
n3.en: Good to have met you. Bye!
n3.deliverySL: [warmly] Lepo, da sva se spoznala. [brightly] Adijo!
n3.slowSL: Lepo, da sva se spoznala … Adijo.
n3.deliverySlowSL: [slower] Lepo, da sva se spoznala … [deliberately] Adijo.
